situation: Maximizing cache reuse for MCP operations.
decision: Give every MCP operation a deterministic key: tenant + tool version + canonical arguments + source revision + auth scope; never cache privileged results by argument equality alone.
reasoning_physics: A cache key that omits tenant/permissions/source-version allows cross-tenant cache poisoning and stale-authorization leaks. Deterministic keys make hits reproducible; privileged exclusivity is a legal-safety floor, not an optimization.
